title: EMINA Serum Series 17 ml | Serum Brightening Mencerahkan, Serum Acne, Peeling Serum, Exfoliasi Serum, Glowing

 2. Emina Acne Clear Expert Serum-2% Cica Complex + 1.5% Salicylic Acid + DermaTech Peptide

 3. Emina Pro Peeling Solution - Serum Eksfoliasi 8% AHA + 1% BHA + 6% PHA + Bromelain Enzyme

 Keunggulan:
 - Memperbaiki tekstur kulit
